verdict.rationale: New Relic explicitly supports defining/consuming SLIs and SLOs (Service Level Management) and has a robust NRQL-based alerting system with thresholds and routing, which together enable error-budget-style tracking and burn-rate-style alerting via custom NRQL queries. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions 'error budget burn rate' as a named alert type or built-in feature, and no independent/hands-on confirmation exists that burn-rate alerting works well in practice. missing for 10: explicit built-in burn-rate alert templates/documentation, independent verification of SLO/error-budget alerting in production use.
